# vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp

## Overview

[`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L1-L22) implements the `sparse_resources.multisampled_image_sparse_binding` top-level branch registered by the sparse-resource dispatcher ([`vktSparseResourcesTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesTests.cpp#L58), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L710-L713)). The Vulkan API test plan treats sparse resources as a separate feature area, and this file specializes that area to sparse-bound 2D multisampled storage images driven by a compute shader ([`apitests.adoc`](../../../../../doc/testspecs/VK/apitests.adoc#L273-L276), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L186-L214)).

## Role

Implementation-heavy Level-3 registration file. It creates the `multisampled_image_sparse_binding` group and registers one direct child per image format; each format child contains sample-count cases generated by the common builder ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L671-L707), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L710-L713)).

```text
sparse_resources.multisampled_image_sparse_binding

```

## Test Families

### rgba32f — floating-point RGBA32 multisample sparse-binding cases

This direct child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT` in the file-local `formats` table and then populated with `samples_2`, `samples_4`, `samples_8`, `samples_16`, `samples_32`, and `samples_64` cases ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L674-L701)). The generated compute shader uses `image2DMS`, stores the selected sample count into sample 0, reloads it, and writes an `r32ui` result image ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L186-L214)).

### rgba16f — floating-point RGBA16 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child follows the same sample-count matrix as `rgba32f`, but uses `VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT` from the format table ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L674-L685)).

### r32f — floating-point R32 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child follows the same sample-count matrix, using `VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT` and the same fixed `256x128x1` 2D image size ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L674-L701)).

### rgba32ui — unsigned-integer RGBA32 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is one of the unsigned integer formats in the table. `getFormatPrefix()` selects `u` for unsigned formats so shader declarations and vectors become unsigned-image forms ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L107-L130), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L193-L210)).

### rgba16ui — unsigned-integer RGBA16 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT` and receives the same six sample-count cases as the other formats ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L677-L701)).

### rgba8ui — unsigned-integer RGBA8 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT`, using the common sparse-image binding and compute verification flow ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L677-L701)).

### r32ui — unsigned-integer R32 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT`; the output image also uses `VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT` for result collection ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L196-L210), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L373-L379)).

### rgba32i — signed-integer RGBA32 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is one of the signed integer formats; `getFormatPrefix()` selects `i` for signed formats in the generated shader image declarations and vector constructors ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L120-L124), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L193-L210)).

### rgba16i — signed-integer RGBA16 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT` and is populated with the same six sample-count cases ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L679-L701)).

### rgba8i — signed-integer RGBA8 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT` and shares the same sparse bind, dispatch, and readback path as the other formats ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L679-L701)).

### r32i — signed-integer R32 multisample sparse-binding cases

This child is generated from `VK_FORMAT_R32_SINT` and completes the direct format-child set ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L679-L701)).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values / source |
|---|---|
| Direct children | Eleven format groups are created from the static `formats` array ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L674-L690)). |
| Nested cases | Each format receives `samples_2`, `samples_4`, `samples_8`, `samples_16`, `samples_32`, and `samples_64` from the `samples` array ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L682-L701)). |
| Image shape | All cases use `IMAGE_TYPE_2D`, one mip level, one layer, and `tcu::UVec3(256, 128, 1)` ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L266-L283), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L696-L700)). |

## Support / Feature Requirements

Each case requires `sparseBinding`, rejects unsupported image sizes, requires `shaderStorageImageMultisample`, verifies image format support for 2D optimal storage images, and checks that the requested sample count is supported ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L159-L184)). Runtime setup creates sparse-binding and compute queues, checks sparse image format support with `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT`, rejects allocations larger than `sparseAddressSpaceSize`, and selects a compatible memory type before `vkQueueBindSparse` ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L246-L257), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L285-L354)).

## Verification Methods

The test binds every alignment-sized range of the sparse multisampled image through `VkSparseImageOpaqueMemoryBindInfo`, waits on a sparse-bind semaphore, dispatches a compute shader over the full image extent, copies the result image to a host-visible buffer, and passes only if every output element equals the requested sample count ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L312-L367), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L419-L518)).

## Test Principles Observed

- The branch validates sparse binding of multisampled storage images by combining `vkQueueBindSparse` with shader write/read access, not by checking image creation alone ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L266-L354), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L464-L518)).
- Format families share one fixed image shape and differ primarily by shader image type prefix and format qualifier ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L107-L130), [`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L674-L701)).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- No nested registered source file was found for this branch; helper routines are contained in the same file and shared sparse utilities ([`vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesMultisampledImageSparseBinding.cpp#L521-L662)).
